transcript: "At our food day we tried sushi from Japan, samosa from India, falafel from the Middle East, and pierogi from Poland. The most popular dish was the falafel wrap, partly because it was the warmest."

label: Text 2
transcript: "My favourite dish is Spätzle with cheese. My grandmother makes it on cold Sundays. The dough is thick and yellow. We eat it with crispy onions on top, and the kitchen smells of fried onion for an hour."
